body: Large language model-based multi-agent systems are evolving from fixed interaction topologies toward dynamically orchestrated Agent Swarms. However, existing benchmarks are still largely based on single-agent or general-purpose agent tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate key orchestration capabilities. We propose SwarmBench, a benchmark that evaluates model performance from multiple perspectives, including accuracy, efficiency, cost, and process quality. Experimental results show that current models exhibit substantial differences in orchestration capability. These differences are reflected not only in final accuracy, efficiency, and cost, but also in the overall quality of the orchestration process itself. Based on these findings, we further propose SwarmExp, a simple yet effective method based on experience extraction and experience replay, which consistently improves the orchestration performance of large language models.
summaryZh: SwarmBench是一个专门评估大模型作为智能体集群编排者能力的基准测试。该基准从准确性、效率、成本和过程质量等多个维度对模型进行评估，揭示了当前模型在集群编排能力上的显著差异。此外，研究还提出了SwarmExp方法，通过经验提取与重放机制，有效提升了模型在复杂集群任务中的编排性能，为多智能体系统的动态协作提供了新的优化路径。

glossary.explanationZh: 智能体集群，指多个智能体协同工作的动态系统。
编排，指对多个智能体任务分配与协作流程的控制。
经验提取，从过往执行记录中总结有效策略的过程。
经验重放，利用历史数据进行模型训练或策略优化的技术。
